text:
rowan: Quick note from the quarterly access census: found several principals with project-level KMS roles on the prod keyrings that look suspiciously broad. Opening this thread to coordinate evidence collection and a safe prune (ticket SEC-5999).

mica: can you paste the raw findings so we can triage?

rowan: redacted list: 
- serviceAccount:legacy-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com (roles/cloudkms.admin)
- user:contractor-jane@example.com (roles/cloudkms.admin)
- group:old-infra-admins@redwood.com (roles/editor)
- serviceAccount:metrics-exporter@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com (roles/editor)

rowan: query used to find them:
```bash
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.role | test("cloudkms|editor"))'
```

ops-oncall: thanks. i'll run last-use checks against audit logs and scheduler. prefer to do a canary revoke during the maintenance window and snapshot policies before/after.

sasha: contractor-jane offboarded mid-2025 per HR; i'll confirm with HR but likely safe to remove.

mica: important: for groups like old-infra-admins, propose we narrow the binding to roles/cloudkms.cryptoOperator and create direct bindings for verified members instead of a group-level Editor. reduces blast radius.

rowan: agreed. plan: 1) collect owner and last-call evidence, 2) post snapshots to gs://redwood-audit/SEC-5999/, 3) run a single-SA canary revoke (dry-run first), 4) 48h rollback watch, 5) finalize removals and update least-priv dashboard.

ops-oncall: revoke dry-run (example):
```bash
# dry-run remove admin role for SA
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member='serviceAccount:legacy-ingest@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/cloudkms.admin' --format=json --dry-run
```

ops-oncall: actual steps i'll take if approved: snapshot policy -> gcs copy -> commit remove -> post snapshot. Will tag ops incident if rollback needed.

sasha: BigQuery to surface last KMS calls by principal (use this for evidence):
```sql
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS principal,
       MAX(timestamp) AS last_call,
       COUNT(1) AS calls
FROM `redwood-logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity`
WHERE resource.type='cloud_kms_key'
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 365 DAY)
GROUP BY principal
ORDER BY last_call DESC
```

rowan: please attach the BigQuery output to SEC-5999. compliance will want the pre/post snapshots and a brief justification for each removal.

compliance: note: for any contractor principals please attach HR offboard confirmation before removal. also request we tag each snapshot with the ticket id and operator email.

mica: one nuance: metrics-exporter has Editor but only uses read-only KMS operations via a wrapped exporter in prod. i'd rather change to a role-limited binding (roles/cloudkms.viewer or a custom role) than full removal. i'll draft the least-priv change and post diff.

ops-oncall: timeline? i can run the canary in the mw 23:00-01:00 PST tonight if evidence attached.

rowan: aiming to collect evidence by 18:00 PT, decide on canary by 19:30, ops runs during MW if approved. i'll update SEC-5999 with snapshots and the justification table.

audit-bot: automated: scheduled snapshot created at gs://redwood-audit/SEC-5999/pre-2799994321.json and log export job queued (audit-job-2799994321).

rowan: thanks all. quick ask: include the exact revert commands in the ticket so rollback is 1-click for oncall. will follow up here with the revert snippet. :thumbsup:
